title: Phantom Blade Zero · Mod Manager
name: Mod
experimental: These mods are experimental; installation does not verify gameplay behavior.
running: Game is running. Inspection is available; changes require closing the game.
menu: 1 Refresh  2 Install / update  3 Enable  4 Disable  5 Restore backup  6 Config path  7 Backups  0 Exit
save_not_found: Steam main save not found; the pre-install backup could not be created.
baseline: Recorded installed file hashes: {count} mods. Game files were not changed.
help:
PhantomBladeModManager.exe status|record|backups|set-game <PBZ>|controls|map-settings|install <id>|on <id>|off <id>|restore <id>|restore-save [id] [--game <PBZ>] [--locale en|zh-CN] [--json] [--dry-run]
Install updates existing copies and keeps their config and map markers. Disable moves the mod out of ~mods. Restore uninstalls mod files; restore-save restores the pre-install save backup. All writes require a closed game.
game_not_found: Game directory not found. Click the folder button to select it or use --game <PBZ>.
game_running: Close Phantom Blade Zero before changing mods.
invalid_game: The selected folder is not a complete Steam Phantom Blade Zero installation.
incompatible_build: Current game build ({actual}) differs from the mod's target build ({expected}).
unsupported_loader: This mod requires the loader and layout hashes in its manifest.
unsafe_path: A path leaves its expected directory or contains a link.
budget_exceeded: The mod exceeds the file-count or size limit.
invalid_data: Invalid manager state or mod configuration.
duplicate_mod: The mod exists in both enabled and disabled locations. Resolve this before changing it.
missing_baseline: No recorded hashes. Run record to inventory the existing installation first.
changed_file: An installed code file changed since it was recorded. It was not overwritten.
target_modified: Installed file differs from its recorded version: {target}
source_changed: Source files changed while preparing the update. Retry.
no_backup: There is no update backup for this mod.
no_save_backup: No save backup available to restore.
operation_locked: Another manager operation is active, or an interrupted operation needs review. Inspect .local/operation.lock.
build_tool_missing: {tool} was not found. Set {variable} to its installation path.
terminal_required: The menu requires an interactive terminal. Use status for a noninteractive report.
restore_note: Uninstall removes the installed mod files and keeps current config and map markers. Use Restore save backup to restore game saves.
retired_mod: This mod's functionality has been removed. Enabling or restoring an older version is unavailable.
gui_restoreSave: Restore pre-install save backup for selected mod
gui_commandFailed: The mod manager command did not complete.
map_close_game: Exit the game to save settings
puerts_map_operation: This map backend supports install, enable and disable. Previous native DLLs remain disabled.
puerts_package_missing: Build the PuerTS map package first.
puerts_map_open_only: Map functions run only while the map page is open.
controls_scopeNote:
